author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads records from five Kaseya VSA 9.5 Data Warehouse API datasets. VSA 9.5 has no syslog or webhook export for these logs, so bridges/kaseya-vsa95-data-warehouse pulls the datasets and posts each record to HTTP Ingest. Every record goes to CloudAudit.
notes:
Setup:
- VSA 9.5 has no syslog or webhook export for these logs, so bridges/kaseya-vsa95-data-warehouse pulls five Data Warehouse API datasets (RemoteControlSessions, RemoteControlFileTransferSessions, AgentLiveConnectAuditLogs, LiveConnectOnDemandAudit and ConfigurationChangeEvents).
- The bridge posts each record to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration with the dataset name as the first key.
- VSA 10 is a different product with its own entry (parsers/kaseya/vsa-10).

Field mapping:
- Every record goes to CloudAudit with the technician, address, session type, status and description.
- The datasets identify machines by AgentId, not name.

Sources and licenses:
- Field names come from the Data Warehouse API reference (R95), which shows only placeholder values.

Made up in the samples:
- The samples' values, including session types, statuses and log text, are made up.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (39 of 39 fields matched the emulator).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.
